mechanism_of_action: Pan-PPAR agonist that modulates metabolic, inflammatory, and fibrogenic pathways.
primary_endpoint: At 24 weeks, decrease of at least 2 points in SAF-A score without worsening of fibrosis.
efficacy_outcome: Primary endpoint met with lanifibranor 1200 mg vs placebo (55% vs 33%, P=0.007), but not with 800 mg (48% vs 33%, P=0.07).
safety_signal: Adverse-event dropout rate was <5% and similar across groups. Diarrhea, nausea, peripheral edema, anemia, and weight gain occurred more frequently with lanifibranor than placebo.
